scope: header_ecc.py217-510 read fully. Static command parameter/precomputation/generation-start review; rest of module not yet whole reviewed.

findings.detail: Unlike adaptive module, header generation estimates percentage with max(1,sizetotal), avoiding zero-total division in that specific calculation. Do not transfer adaptive defect wholesale to header implementation.
Rejects resilience rates<=0, block size outside2..255 and header_size<1. Nonfinite and arbitrarily high rates have no explicit rejection here; compute_ecc_params may yield unusable message sizes.

Header size is user-controlled positive integer with no upper bound or memory budget; entry_assemble reads whole header and builds list of all blocks. Streaming codec granularity does not bound header allocation.

Precomputation traverses filesystem separately from generation. Files can change between size estimate, metadata and content reads; no stable source snapshot or omission completeness report visible in reviewed path.
Generation output DB/index paths are not excluded from recursive input roots in this path; placing generated files inside input needs dedicated qualification. No such experiment performed.

generate/correct are independent boolean flags rather than mutually exclusive required mode; selecting neither still reaches precomputation and may return None later. Full end-of-module behavior not yet inspected.
